# Route2 Logistics officially opens new depot in Coatbridge

## Located at 8 Palacecraig Street, nestled between the M8 and M73, the new 22,000-sq ft facility provides additional warehousing, yard space and vehicle capacity.

In Your Area Ian Bunting

22:50, 14 Aug 2026

View Image

Route2 owner Joe Wall and operations manager Rodger Caldwell

Route2 Logistics has officially opened its new depot in Coatbridge, marking a major milestone in the continued growth of the specialist haulage and pallet distribution business.

Located at 8 Palacecraig Street, nestled between the M8 and M73, the new 22,000-sq ft facility provides additional warehousing, yard space and vehicle capacity, creating a significant new operational base for Route2 in the West of Scotland.

The Coatbridge depot complements Route2’s established Dunfermline operation, creating a stronger Scotland-based network and enabling the business to provide faster lead times, greater capacity and flexibility for companies delivering products to customers across Scotland.

# Evri invests £1.3m in new Gloucester parcel depot

 October 12, 2026 Mark Salisbury Filed under: Last Mile Deliveries, Logistics, Manufacturer News, News, Newsletter, Secondary News, Third-Party Logistics (3PL) 

Evri Group has opened a new £1.3 million depot in Gloucester, expanding its parcel delivery network across the South West and creating dozens of permanent jobs.

The new facility at Indurent Park Gloucester in Quedgeley replaces the company’s previous operation in Tewkesbury, which had reached capacity. The investment will help Evri manage rising parcel volumes, strengthen regional operations and improve its ability to meet customer demand.

The depot has created 38 permanent roles across warehouse, driving, operational and management functions. The investment also supports local employment while providing additional capacity for the growing logistics business.

Image: Evri

# Warehouse pioneers robotics system used in China

Image source, Kate Bradbrook/BBC

Image caption, Brian Luck says the Northampton warehouse is a "pioneering site" with its robotic system

By Kate Bradbrook, in Northampton and Louise Parry

27 September 2026

A new giant warehouse in England's logistics "golden triangle" is adopting pioneering technology previously only used in China, a company said.

Yusen Logistics UK said it will use a robotics and four-way conveyor system at its new site on the edge of Northampton, which will also employ hundreds of staff.

"There are some roles that robots can do better than people, but fundamentally robots don't work without people," said David Evans, the company's managing director.

The Japanese firm opened its 1.1m sq ft (102,193 sq m) site with a fusion ceremony that included a traditional counting song, sushi, and fish and chips.

# LDC-backed Cleveland Group opens new Doncaster depot as national expansion continues

18 Aug 2026

Cleveland Group has continued its rapid national expansion with the opening of a new Cleveland-operated depot in Doncaster, strengthening its ability to serve customers across South Yorkshire and the wider Yorkshire region.

The new depot is the latest addition to Cleveland’s growing UK network, following the opening of a new 5-acre depot in Newport, South Wales, in 2025. The Doncaster site builds on Cleveland Group’s existing Cleveland-operated locations in Newport, Middlesbrough, Ashby de la Zouch and Cambuslang, as the business continues to invest in its infrastructure, people and operational capabilities.

Based in Stockton-on-Tees, Cleveland Group comprises Cleveland Containers, Cleveland Modular and Cleveland Hire, providing customers nationwide with shipping containers, modular buildings, site accommodation, and bespoke conversion solutions.

# Savona Foodservice invests £3 million in London depot

#### Savona Foodservice has officially opened its new London distribution depot.

The 50,000 sq ft site in Barking has given the wholesaler a larger, more efficient facility than its previous 6,000 sq ft depot in Beckton. At the heart of a £3 million investment in the premises is a substantial increase in warehouse capacity, including over 2,000 additional freezer and chiller pallet spaces. This means greater product availability and the ability to offer a broader range of products.

The company has also introduced new racking systems and an upgraded warehouse layout. The London depot has also taken on some delivery areas previously covered by its Oxford branch.

“For our customers, the result is simple: more capacity behind the scenes, helping us deliver the reliable service they know and expect from Savona,” says a company spokesperson.

# EXCLUSIVE: J&T Express opens Glasgow depot

Posted on Tuesday 6 October 2026 Share: 

Hong Kong Stock Exchange listed international delivery and logistics company J&T Express has opened a warehouse depot in Glasgow,

By Liza Helps, Property Editor, Logistics Matters

THE COMPANY has secured a circa.70,000 ft2 ft2 warehouse at Mileway’s 2-20 Napier Place in Cumbernauld as it rapidly rolls out its services following its soft launch in the UK in June.

The property totals 68,854 ft2 and has been recently refurbished. It consists of two parallel industrial warehouses of steel portal frame construction, separated by a generous secure yard and parking totalling 0.68 acres. The refurbished units include LED lighting, six electric roller shutter doors, and good quality office space.

The property is located adjacent to the M80 motorway, providing direct access to Central Scotland’s motorway triangle (M8 / M9 / M80) via Junction 6 (Castlecary).
